news_analysis.headline_hook: ITC 68% growth! 1 lakh investment enna aagum?
news_analysis.breaking_event_summary: Brokerage firm 360 ONE reiterated a BUY rating on ITC with an aggressive target price of ₹440, forecasting a 68% upside despite a 35% stock drop over the past year and tax-driven cigarette volume declines.
news_analysis.retail_illusion: Retail investors assume a 68% projected upside means an imminent, risk-free mean reversion trade, believing margin improvements from price hikes can permanently offset shrinking consumer volumes.
news_analysis.institutional_reality: Institutions recognize that masking volume contraction with price hikes reaches a strict consumer elasticity ceiling under persistent tax headwinds. Bullish price targets often anchor to historical terminal multiples rather than structural volume compression, creating exit liquidity for institutional rebalancing.
news_analysis.actionable_retail_rule: Never buy an equity solely on a brokerage percentage upside; verify whether top-line growth is driven by genuine unit volume expansion or defensive price hikes masking demand erosion.
